configurations.name: site-preview
runtimeArgs: $root='C:\desenvolvimento\siteinstitucional'; $l=New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $l.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:5500/'); $l.Start(); $mime=@{'.html'='text/html';'.css'='text/css';'.js'='application/javascript';'.png'='image/png';'.jpg'='image/jpeg';'.svg'='image/svg+xml'}; while($l.IsListening){ try { $c=$l.GetContext(); $req=$c.Request; $res=$c.Response; $res.KeepAlive=$false; $p=$req.Url.LocalPath; if($p -eq '/'){$p='/index.html'}; $fp=Join-Path $root ($p.TrimStart('/')); if(Test-Path $fp -PathType Leaf){ $ext=[System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($fp); $ct=$mime[$ext]; if(-not $ct){$ct='application/octet-stream'}; $b=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($fp); $res.ContentType=$ct; $res.ContentLength64=[int64]$b.Length; $res.OutputStream.Write($b,0,$b.Length); $res.OutputStream.Flush() } else { $res.StatusCode=404 } $res.Close() } catch { } }
